Petroleum / sources and country coverage

OPEC World Oil Outlook 2026 plus independent EIA, ANP Brazil, Statistics Canada and UNSD evidence. Production, throughput, capacity and forecasts remain separate. A regional total is never assigned to each country in that region. Empty cells mean missing, never zero.

OPEC: all 14 workbooks, 202 worksheets and all nonempty cells are retained in the normalized source files. The country index provides direct worksheet/cell references; consult the original headings for component, growth and scenario definitions. Regional series remain in the full cell ledger.

Sources: OPEC · EIA · ANP · Statistics Canada. Local source files and SHA256SUMS: assets.static/petroleum.
